periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the patches is oriented vertically, approximately perpendicular to the horizontal plane of the snout.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature along the superior boundaries of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan discoloration on the ventral fur of the chest and abdominal area.
